scenes.text: Imagine standing in a beautiful section of Yellowstone National Park where the law technically doesn't apply to you, a place famously known as the Zone of Death.
Because of a bizarre constitutional loophole involving federal jurisdictions, you could theoretically commit a serious crime here and walk away completely free.

The Sixth Amendment guarantees your right to a jury from the exact state and district where the crime occurred, but this tiny strip of Idaho land is governed by Wyoming, which has a population of absolutely zero.
Since a legal jury can never be formed here and Congress still hasn't fixed this oversight, would you ever dare to visit this lawless zone? Let me know in the comments and follow for more!
